text: Dear Supplier, due to an internal audit our payment details for the tea export order have been revised. Kindly direct the balance to the account below. Please treat this as strictly confidential and avoid discussing it with our local agent.

Hello, I am the new finance officer of your agricultural buyer. We have an urgent large order of frozen vegetables. Before we can sign, an advance of USD 4,000 must be sent to our agent account. Time is limited.

Attention: the receiving warehouse for the grain shipment has been changed. Update the bill of lading accordingly. Our remittance account has also been updated - see the link http://grain-logistics-port.top/update
Kindly note that from this month all payments for our agricultural cooperation go to a new third-party account. Please amend your records quietly and confirm by replying to this email only.
Our CEO has approved the bulk order of seeds. To proceed, the deposit must reach the offshore account within 24 hours. Do not inform your sales department until completion.
Dear Partner, we are updating our bank information for the coming season. Please pay the outstanding invoice to the new beneficiary. This is urgent as our old account will be closed tomorrow.
Poultry feed order confirmed. Note the change of beneficiary - pay to the intermediary bank account. Keep this confidential. Reply with the transfer receipt today.

We have changed our bank account for all fresh produce transactions. Please update your supplier records. To avoid shipment delay, remit the pre-payment immediately and do not discuss with the logistics team.
Dear Manager, our agricultural trade contract requires a processing fee before release. Send it to the account below. Final notice - expires today. Confidential matter.
Your agri-export settlement account shows unusual activity. Confirm your account and re-enter your credentials here: http://agri-bank-verify.click/login. Account will be suspended within 12 hours.

Dear Partner, the phytosanitary certificate for the tea shipment has been issued and will be couriered to you. Payment remains by irrevocable letter of credit per the signed contract. Please confirm receipt.
Thank you for your inquiry about cold chain logistics for our agricultural products. Our export department is preparing a formal quotation and will respond within five working days.
We acknowledge receipt of your trial order for organic fertilizer. The goods are scheduled for shipment next month from the port of destination. Attached is the draft contract for review.
Dear colleague, thank you for your interest in our crop breeding program. We would be glad to arrange a laboratory visit during your delegation's stay. No fee is charged for academic exchange.
Our cooperative can guarantee a steady supply of agricultural products for the order farming project this season. Please find the production report attached for your reference.
The customs clearance documents for your shipment have been submitted. We will notify you once the inspection report is issued. No payment is required at this stage.
Thank you for the long-term cooperation on agricultural trade. Please find attached the settlement statement for last quarter for your verification.
The international symposium on agricultural economics will be hosted at our university next spring. Submissions on rural development are welcome. There is no registration fee for presenters.
王总您好，由于公司内部调整，我方收款账户已变更。请将本批茶叶出口的尾款汇至以下新账户，此事请保密，不要与我司业务员提及。
您好，我是贵司农产品采购方的财务负责人。现有一批冷冻蔬菜大单需要紧急确认，需先支付订金到我方指定离岸账户，名额有限，速办。
关于粮食订单：收货地址已变更，请同步修改提单。另外我方汇款账户已更新，请按以下账户打款，尽快办理。
通知：自本月起农业合作款项一律打入新的第三方账户。请低调更新贵司记录，仅回复本邮件确认即可。
我方已批准种子大宗订单。请于24小时内将订金汇至离岸账户，此事保密处理，请勿告知贵司销售人员。
张经理你好，我方银行信息更新，请把待付发票款项打款给新的收款人。原账户明天停用，抓紧时间汇款。
禽类饲料订单已确认。注意收款人已更换，请汇款至以下账户，保密处理，今日回复转账凭证。
关于农产品出口结算：我方账户异常，请重新登录验证并更新付款信息，12小时内未处理账户将被冻结。
您好，本批茶叶出口的植物检疫证书已签发，将快递至贵司。货款仍按合同约定的不可撤销即期信用证结算，请查收。
感谢贵司咨询我方农产品的冷链物流方案。外贸部正在准备正式报价，将于五个工作日内回复，谢谢耐心等待。
我方已收到贵司有机肥试用订单。货物计划下月自目的港发运，随函附上合同草案，请审阅。
我院作物育种项目欢迎贵单位来访交流，期间可安排实验室参观。学术交流不收取任何费用。
本季合作社可稳定供应订单农业所需农产品，随函附上生产情况报告，请查阅。
贵司货物的报关资料已提交，检验报告出具后我方将第一时间通知。此阶段无需贵方付款。
